lineage.strategy: Use a materially different current commercial-distribution source: the September 8 Palantir partnership, rather than repeat Q2 operating evidence.

observations.fact: Nebius and Palantir announced on September 8 that Palantir named Nebius its preferred sovereign AI infrastructure partner and, following integration, intends to bring Nebius compute and inference endpoints inside the Palantir enterprise perimeter for eligible commercial customers.

risks.risk: The announcement does not disclose contract value, committed capacity, customer volumes, revenue contribution, margins or conversion timing; preferred-partner status is therefore distribution evidence rather than quantified economics.

unknowns.unknown: Incremental bookings, utilization and unit economics attributable to the Palantir channel remain unquantified.

recommendation: Use as source-addressed enterprise distribution and sovereign-AI execution evidence alongside, not instead of, the Q2 operating baseline; Alpha retains numeric underwriting authority.
